question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word. **
solution:
Here, the correct answer is** "Protesion."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the wrongly spelt word is "Protesion."
 
• The correct spelling is "Protection."
 
• It means the act of keeping somebody/something safe so that he/she/it is not harmed or damaged. (सुरक्षा, हिफ़ाज़त)
 
 
• Example:* Vaccination gives **protection**__ against diseases.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Unshielded: **not protected or shielded. (संरक्षित या परिरक्षित नहीं)
 
• **Activity: **a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति)
 
• **Inactivity: **the state of being inactive; idleness. (निष्क्रियता)
